newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NCC holds 32.5 pct of NK Cityfastigheter.
newsitem.headline: NCC holds 32.5 pct of NK Cityfastigheter.

text.p: Swedish construction group NCC said on Friday it had finalised the spin-off and separate listing of NK Cityfastigheter and now holds 32.5 percent or 6.33 million shares in the group.
"NCC has pledged not to sell these shares in 1997 without the approval of Alfred Berg brokerage," it said in a statement.
Alfred Berg has sold 1.13 million shares of the overallotment option totalling 2.4 million shares.
So a total of 13.13 million shares in NK Cityfastigheter have been sold, NCC said.
NK Cityfastigheter's property portfolio comprises the NK properties in Stockholm and Gothenburg as well as centrally located properties in Uppsala, Norrkoping and Sundsvall.
The company was listed in late March with shares sold at 64 crowns each.
NK Cityfastigheter were last traded at 61 crowns.
